meta.title: Wallpaper
meta.description: Replace the flat Harness background with a wallpaper: the default Official style bakes the deepseek.com homepage clouds and fine grid, with an aurora option and image uploads — plus three bundled reading fonts (LXGW WenKai / Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC) and a 90–110% text scale. Host-side storage survives restarts.
